[A10] READY TAKEOVER

Executor: A161 (Codex). Independent reviewers: R229 (cold internal Codex) and R230 (external Opus), to start after review-ready evidence is published. This rotates execution from the previous Opus donor lane. Issue97 has settled scope and is Ready; no design choice remains.

Base: merged main `8452f564294300a82d56eed464276576f65f4d58` from PR96. Branch: `97-assert-distinct-sr-vid-fixture`. Scope and acceptance are the issue contract: compile-time refusal for verification fixtures equal to the product default at either observed width; preserve the normal builds and binding controls. No product RTL/default change. PR26's portability-script lane is excluded.

Validation: author focused default/fixture, equal-value and low-12-bit-alias refusal, dropped-binding and child-default controls; manager complete donor native and hosted bar, then two cold reviews, exact candidate validation and containment. One author only. Parent PR505/507 validations continue in independent checkouts; neither is edited by this lane.

[A161] TAKEN

Author on `97-assert-distinct-sr-vid-fixture`, based on main `8452f564294300a82d56eed464276576f65f4d58`, in the assigned isolated checkout. R229 and R230 remain the manager-assigned independent reviewers; this author task does not start reviews.

Scope: compile-time assertions in the verification fixture branch for distinctness from product default 2 at both the 16-bit wire and 12-bit class-D widths; focused executable coverage and pp_top README contract. Default compilation continues without a fixture override, and expected values remain independent of DUT readback. No product RTL/default/Domain change or adjacent documentation inventory work.

Validation: default and pinned 5A3C, explicit 0002/1002 compilation refusal with diagnostic checks, real missing-binding negative and child-default positive controls, and relevant donor documentation/lint/format gates. Fixture and RTL probes run sequentially in disposable scratch copies with all compile jobs capped at 8, including Verilator build jobs. Full native/hosted validation, publication, two cold independent reviews and merge/containment remain with the manager. No push, PR creation, parent pin/workflow/other-checkout edit, hardware, Docker/act, privileged action or other agent.

[A161] MATERIAL DECISIONS

The verification-only `sim_main.cpp` branch now asserts distinctness after conversion to the existing `uint16_t` expectation, then after masking to 12 bits. Diagnostics identify the product default and failing observable width. The no-override branch and all DV runtime expectations are unchanged.

`make fixture-guards`, also required by the normal pp_top run, compiles the actual bench against temporary generated model headers. It accepts no override and 5A3C, requires both assertion diagnostics for 0002, and requires only the class-D diagnostic for 1002. Other compiler errors fail the check. This adds no product parameter restriction and changes no RTL.

The focused four-case gate, documentation gates and 37-module zero-tolerance HDL lint pass locally. Full pp_top and sequential disposable binding controls are in progress. Full native/hosted bar and R229/R230 review remain manager-owned.

[A161] AUTHOR HANDOFF

Committed clean head `1eb20dc4911880de10b745cc284e7dde306788b5` on `97-assert-distinct-sr-vid-fixture`, based on `8452f564294300a82d56eed464276576f65f4d58`. Four pp_top test/README files only; no RTL/default/Domain, wrapper, workflow, parent pin or other-checkout change. Not pushed; no PR or reviews started.

Results, with all compile jobs capped at 8 and controls sequential in disposable scratch copies:

- Default build: 1391 checks, 0 failures, no fixture override. Pinned 5A3C: 20 checks, 0 failures. Canonical total: 1411 PASS, 0 FAIL.
- 0002 full fixture compilation refuses with both 16-bit wire and 12-bit class-D assertions; 1002 refuses with the class-D assertion only. Both exit 2 before producing a fixture executable.
- Actual missing top-to-child binding: default remains 1391/0; fixture reports the recorded 13 failures out of 20.
- Child default changed to 7, binding intact: both builds remain green.
- Permanent four-case `make fixture-guards` passes. Removing either assertion separately makes that gate fail.
- `make check`: all documentation gates pass, including matrix freshness and zero untested modules. HDL lint: 37 LINT OK. Python syntax, diff formatting, scope, tested-source hashes and final clean-tree checks pass.

Factual HANDOFF.md, PR-BODY.md, REVIEW-READY.md, exact command/result logs, mutation patches/hashes and remaining-gate inventory are ready in the assigned local author evidence directory for manager publication. Local Verilator is 5.052; hosted pin is v5.050.

Remaining manager bar: full native suites, Yosys and historical nvm_port figures; exact-head hosted docs-gates/suites/portability; R229/R230 cold independent reviews with clean five-lens ledgers; candidate validation and post-merge containment. This author evidence is not an approval or a claim that the merge bar is complete.
